notes.drawing: text-wrap with a slash at bell-slash's angle, but only as long as the text block, as text-t-slash's slash runs 16 units past its T's top bar and foot (round 3: the maintainer didn't want it edge to edge). It lies on bell-slash's line and runs from y 48 to 208, 16 past the top and bottom rows: (55.27,48) to (200.73,208). Every part on the lower-left side runs into the slash; every part on the upper-right side stops 32 units from its centerline (cut ends computed on the lines, the curl and the arrowhead). The top and middle lines each keep a short left piece; the curl keeps its upper half and the arrowhead's upper arm ends on the slash.
notes.fill: As text-t-slash-fill: a filled rounded square with the glyph and the slash both cut out in white. The slash runs 16 past the glyph's rows (y 64 to 192) on a line 16 units left of the line weights' one, so the smaller curl keeps its upper half; the glyph's upper-right parts stop 32 from it (16 dark between the white lines), and the top line's left end (4 units long) is dropped, as text-t-slash-fill drops its top bar's left end.
notes.duotone: text-wrap's tint with a white band 0–24 units on the slash's upper-right side, as image-slash-duotone.
